mapper.select: SELECT song_id AS songId, track_id AS trackId, track_name AS trackName, artist_name AS artistName, artwork_url AS artworkUrl, preview_url AS previewUrl, apple_music_url AS appleMusicUrl FROM songs WHERE song_id = #{songId}

SELECT song_id AS songId, track_id AS trackId, track_name AS trackName, artist_name AS artistName, artwork_url AS artworkUrl, preview_url AS previewUrl, apple_music_url AS appleMusicUrl FROM songs WHERE track_id = #{trackId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO songs (song_id, track_id, track_name, artist_name, artwork_url, preview_url, apple_music_url) VALUES (#{songId}, #{trackId}, #{trackName}, #{artistName}, #{artworkUrl}, #{previewUrl}, #{appleMusicUrl});
